experience.title: Analyst, Platform Engineering
highlights: Implemented client-side image prefetching in Kotlin, fetching images ahead of the user's scroll position; the experiment increased PDP opens and GMV per visitor by 0.6%.

Built client-side bandwidth estimation using image download speed and TTFD, initializing measurements across the first five images and applying EWMA smoothing while tuning alpha/beta parameters for network-condition estimation.
Integrated ExoPlayer bandwidth telemetry in the production Android application to capture download-speed signals and feed the bandwidth-estimation pipeline.
Instrumented media and network latency signals and fixed a TTFD measurement issue, improving performance-analysis accuracy across client experiences.
Contributed to Global Image Resize, enabling 1024px images for higher-bandwidth devices and contributing to a measured 0.9% NMV uplift in experimentation.
Shipped production changes through pull requests, reviewed code, tested Android flows, and used application logs to debug and validate releases.

projects.name: FootballBuzz

projects.description: Built and deployed a football platform for live scores, player profiles, statistics, teams, news, and match videos, backed by a dedicated Node.js/Express service.

Normalized player data across external APIs by persisting fetched profiles locally, so frequently searched players load without repeated upstream queries.
Structured the backend with controllers, services, models, routes, middleware, and background task processing, with retry and rate-control utilities for external API calls.
